AlertBot: Elevated 5xxs and token latency detected in eu-west-1 at 20:11 UTC; auto-incident created.
Ivy Chen: Quick triage shows a rapid drop in KV cache hit rate correlated with a burst of small writes. eviction_rate spiked ~6x.
Marco Rivera: Temporary mitigation: disable prefetch for eu-west runtime and set max_prefix_concurrency=6. Applying now to blue pool.
Priya Shah: Enabling automatic fallback to quantized companion variants for sensitive customers. Fallback currently ~9%.
CS Notify: Sending heads-up to affected customers and CS reps. Draft: "Transient performance degradation in EU region; mitigations in place."
AlertBot: Canary on eu-w-19 applied; 5xxs down ~50% on canary within 90s.
Marco Rivera: Rolling hotfix to throttle aggressive evictions (rev: evict-throttle-031). Staggered rollout across remaining pools.
Priya Shah: Monitoring: 9/12 pools showing recovery; token latency trending down. Remaining pools likely impacted by client retry storm; investigating throttles at ingress.
Ivy Chen: Next steps: complete rollout, run postmortem with action items (client rate-limiting, improved eviction alerts), share initial draft within 48 hours.
StatusBot: Incident page queued: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1812345678 (public update pending). Final internal status: mitigated; monitoring; CS outreach in progress.
